//: Copy to %ProgramData%\PanRaProxy\appsettings.json and adapt. Settings here override the defaults in the install folder. Secrets never go in this file: set them with Set-PanRaProxySecret.ps1.

UserId.//: TimeoutMinutes must be at least twice InterimIntervalMinutes, the interval the NAS sends Interim-Updates at.

Domain.//: Turns the three username forms into the Canonical Username. DefaultNt4Domain is for bare usernames; UpnSuffixes maps each UPN suffix to its NT4 domain. It assumes the UPN prefix equals the account name: where it doesn't, turn NameTranslation on (Windows, domain-joined) and set DefaultUpnSuffix.

UsernameRewrites.//: Escape hatch, applied before the domain rules.
